Claim 1 (Currently amended): An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, wherein the control means is further configured to adjust the operation of the first and second valves based on feedback from one or more sensors.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising plural first valves and/or plural second valves, wherein at least one of the plural first valves or plural second valves is a larger valve arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators, and at least one of the binary actuators is configured to provide variable actuation based on the control means.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, and is further arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor for optimizing braking performance.
